description: Google Pixel 11 has been launched in India, and the new Pixel smartphone competes directly with Apple's iPhone 17, which was unveiled in September last year. The Google Pixel 11 sports a 6.3-inch (1,080 x 2,424 pixels) OLED Actua display, with up to a 120Hz refresh rate, while the iPhone 17 is equipped with a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display. The Google Pixel 11 is equipped with the latest Google Tensor G6 chipset. On the other hand, the iPhone 17 is powered by the A19 chipset, featuring a 16-core Neural Engine.
title: Google Pixel 11 vs iPhone 17: Price in India and Full Specifications Compared

description: Google Pixel Tag has been launched in India. It is the first Bluetooth tracker from the Mountain View-based tech giant, which will compete directly with Apple's AirTag in the country. The company has announced that its first Bluetooth tracker will go on sale in the country in November via the Google India online store. It is offered in a single Fog colourway. The Google Pixel Tag will be available for purchase as packs of one and four. It features a polycarbonate and metal body. The Google Pixel Tag ships with an IP67 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: Google Pixel Tag Launched as Apple AirTag Competitor in India: Price and Features

description: The Google Pixel 11 series is here. Google’s latest flagship smartphone lineup comprises four models — Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL and the company's new foldable, the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. All of the Pixel 11 models are powered by Google's Tensor G6 chipset and run Android 17. Along with the global markets, all of the latest handsets will also be making their way to India, with sales beginning August 20.
title: Google Pixel 11 Price in India: Your Complete Guide to the New Pixel 11 Series

description: Pixel 11 series has been officially launched in India. The company has introduced the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL smartphones in the country.
title: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL Launched in India with Tensor G6 SoC, Triple Rear Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold has been launched in India. The smartphone is the Mountain View-based tech giant's latest book-style foldable phone. The book-style foldable is available for pre-order in India via Amazon and the Google India online store. The smartphone is offered in a single Olive colourway. The Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold ships with the latest Android 17 out of the box. The tech giant promises seven years of OS upgrades and seven years of security and Pixel Drop updates. The Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold is equipped with an 8-inch (2,076 x 2,152 pixels) OLED Super Actua Flex display on the inside, offering up to a 120Hz refresh rate, 372 ppi pixel density, 16 million colours, up to 3,600 nits peak brightness, and HDR support.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold Launched in India With 8-Inch Super Actua Flex Display, HiLight Indicator: Price, Features

description: Google Pixel Watch 5 was launched in India on Wednesday as the latest smartwatch in the company’s lineup. It brings a brighter 3,000 nits display and a faster Qualcomm Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated processor. The smartwatch features deeper Gemini integration, while introducing new Health Guardian features like breathing emergency detection and monthly health trend summaries. The Pixel Watch 5 is claimed to deliver up to 40 hours of battery life on a single charge.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Launched in India With Dual-Chip Architecture, Health Guardian Features: Price, Specifications

description: Harmony is exploring a possible blockchain rollback after an alleged exploit led to the unauthorised minting of nearly 4 billion ONE tokens, equivalent to around 26 percent of its existing supply. The network has released an emergency patch, halted its token bridge and worked with exchanges to freeze suspicious funds. Harmony said thousands of transfers involving hundreds of wallets have been traced as it continues investigating the incident and assessing how to handle the newly minted tokens.
title: Harmony Plans Blockchain Rollback After Hacker Allegedly Mints Nearly 4 Billion ONE Tokens

description: Binance has rejected RedotPay’s claim that its Singapore lawsuit could be discontinued, saying it remains committed to its claims in the dispute. The case was filed by Binance-linked Chaintecs Consulting Singapore against RedotPay affiliates and is separate from a Hong Kong lawsuit seeking nearly $473 million (roughly Rs. 4,510 crore). RedotPay said it expects the Singapore case to be dropped and plans to seek legal costs from the claimant if the proceedings are discontinued.
title: Binance Rejects Claim of Withdrawing Singapore Lawsuit Against RedotPay

description: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has seen a live playthrough of The Elder Scrolls 6 at Bethesda Game Studios. The Xbox chief said the game's scale and grandeur were "incredible." She added that the story was "even greater." The Elder Scrolls 6 is currently in development at Bethesda.
title: Xbox CEO Calls The Elder Scrolls 6 'Incredible' After Seeing Live Playthrough, Teases Official Subtitle

description: Honor Robot Phone launched in China with a triple rear camera system headlined by a 200-megapixel main camera. It has a gimbal camera attached to its back. The flagship phone has a 6.31-inch OLED display and runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. It comes with 16GB of LPDDR5X RAM and 1TB of internal storage. The Honor Robot Phone packs a 7,060mAh battery and supports up to 120W wired charging.
title: Honor Robot Phone Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, 200-Megapixel Gimbal Camera: Price, Features

description: Apple Arcade will add two puzzle games in September, alongside three other titles and several updates to existing games. Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ will arrive on September 3, while NFL Retro Bowl ’27, Colouring Games for Families+ and Let’s Play! Oink Games+ will also join the service that day. August updates include new packs for puffies., 200 levels for Simon’s Cat - Blast Time and a milestone update for Stitch. The catalogue has more than 200 games.
title: Apple Arcade Announces Block Blast!+, Art of Fauna: Cosy Puzzles+ and More Games: All You Need to Know

description: Different smartphones across different price segments are listed in Amazon's Great Freedom Sale.  The special discount brings no-cost EMI options and exchange discounts across popular models. Smartphones including Realme Narzo 100x 5G, Moto G37 5G, and iQOO Z11 Lite are currently listed at discounted prices. Amazon Pay ICICI credit card users can get cashback and welcome points.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Smartphones Under Rs. 20,000

description: The final day of Amazon's sale brings several storage deals for users looking to expand their digital space or back up important files. The lineup includes Seagate's 8TB desktop HDD, a SanDisk 1TB portable SSD, Seagate and UnionSine external drives, Kingster HDDs and flash drives from iDiskk and HP. Prices vary considerably across the selection, while certain listings also include bank discounts, cashback, coupons or no-cost EMI options. The sale ends tonight, giving shoppers limited time to check these offers.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Storage Devices

description: Bumble on Tuesday announced a major change to its signature dating experience. The dating app, which has had a long-standing women-first approach, will now allow both men and women to send the first message after a match. As part of the new chat experience, users will also have up to 72 hours to respond to a match, up from the previous 24-hour window. Bumble says the changes are based on member feedback and product testing.
title: Bumble Changes Its Women-First Dating Model, Now Lets Anyone Send the First Message

description: The Vivo X500 has reportedly cleared China’s 3C certification with 90W charging and N79 5G connectivity, while the iQOO 16 has received approval with 100W charging. The X500 could also support multiple AI platforms and a Beidou satellite communication variant. Earlier leaks have pointed to three main X500 models with different displays, chipsets and camera systems. The range may also include an X500e. The X500 series is tipped to launch in September, followed by the iQOO 16.
title: Vivo X500, iQOO 16 Reportedly Get 3C Certification Ahead of Expected Launch

description: When it comes to battle royale games, few can match the popularity of Battlegrounds Mobile India or BGMI. The game’s developer, Krafton India, periodically releases BGMI redeem codes, which provide players with complimentary access to exclusive in-game rewards like skins, outfits, UC (Unknown Cash), and more. To commemorate the rollout of BGMI’s 5th Anniversary Edition 4.5 update, Krafton India has released 50 new redeem codes that allow players an opportunity to claim in-game rewards for a limited time.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes: How to Claim Mecha Ant Backpack, Free Rewards, Skins, UC, and More

description: Google’s Pixel 11 series could be more expensive in India than its predecessors. The standard Pixel 11 will reportedly be priced at Rs. 89,999 for the base variant, up from Rs. 79,999 for the Pixel 10. The Pixel 11 Pro could start at Rs. 1,19,999, compared with Rs. 1,09,999 for the Pixel 10 Pro. Google is offering customers a special discount on the upcoming Pixel devices in the US and India. The company is providing Rs. 2,000 off on eligible Pixel Buds or Pixel Watch when they are purchased together with a new Pixel 11 series phone.
title: Google Pixel 11 Series Price in India Leaked Ahead of Today's Launch; Pre-Order Offer Revealed

description: The Amazon Great Freedom Sale has entered its final day in India. This means shoppers only have limited time to purchase all the products on their wishlist before the sale event ends tonight. If you’ve been thinking of upgrading your smartphone but have yet to do so, it can be a great avenue for purchasing one before memory prices cause further price hikes across the smartphone industry. There are still several great last-minute deals on popular smartphones from Samsung, iQOO, OnePlus and other brands.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Last-Minute Smartphone Deals on Galaxy S25 Ultra, Redmi Turbo 5, OnePlus Nord 6 and More

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 is offering various gaming peripherals, like controllers, headphones, mice, and keyboards, at discounted prices. You can get your hands on a PowerA gaming controller for your PC, laptop, or console at a discounted price of Rs. 3,149, instead of its listed price of Rs. 5,499. The company is offering an instant discount of 10 percent with an HDFC Bank credit card. Those who do not wish to pay the full amount at once, you can also get a 10 percent discount with an HDFC Bank credit card EMI transaction.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Top Deals on Gaming Peripherals Like Controllers, Headsets, Mice and More

description: More than 50 Motorola smartphones are listed for the Android 17 update, covering the company’s Razr, Edge, Moto G and Signature ranges. The eligibility list includes several models released between 2024 and 2026. The Motorola Edge 2025 has already started receiving the stable update, while other devices will get it in stages. Android 17 is expected to bring changes to multitasking, window management and large-screen support. Users can check for the update through the System Updates section in their phone’s Settings.
title: Motorola Rolling Out Android 17 Update to Razr, Edge and Moto G Phones

description: Phantom Blade Zero is getting a gameplay deep dive at Sony's State of Play broadcast next week. The show will be dedicated to the action title from Chinese developer S-Game. Phantom Blade Zero has also received a new 11-minute trailer, confirming pre-orders for the game.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Is Getting a Gameplay Deep Dive at Sony's Next State of Play Show Next Week

description: An XRP bridge connecting the XRP Ledger with the tx blockchain lost more than 196,000 XRP, worth around $200,000 (roughly Rs. 1.9 crore), after a software bug allowed an attacker to create fake deposits. The exploit drained the bridge’s reserve wallet within 97 minutes on August 9 before the service was shut down. The operator has patched the affected code, contacted blockchain forensics experts, and reported the incident to the FBI.
title: XRP Bridge Hit by $200,000 Loss as Software Accepts Fake Deposits

description: Researchers discovered a critical flaw in Zoom that could allow an attacker to take full control of another user's device during a live meeting without any action from the victim. All Zoom Workplace clients on all supported platforms before versions 7.1.5 and 7.0.6 using end-to-end encryption settings are still vulnerable. The researchers state that the vulnerability is a memory-corruption bug that exploits Zoom's annotation feature.
title: Zoom Fixes Critical Security Flaw That Could Let Attackers Remotely Control Users' Devices

description: Vivo X300 FE has been launched in a new 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration in India, the tech firm announced on Wednesday. The new variant replaces the 12GB + 256GB option as the new base model in the country. The latest storage option is currently on sale in India via Amazon, Flipkart, and the Vivo India online store. This comes a day after the tech firm raised the prices of the existing storage variants in India by Rs. 10,000, as the prices of memory and storage components continue to increase.
title: Vivo X300 FE Launches in New 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage Variant in India: Price, Specifications

description: Sony has announced a new limited-edtion Marvel's Wolverine PS5 console bundle, which comes with a digital edition PS5 console, a matching limited-edition DualSense controller, and a downloaded code for Insomniac Games' Marvel's Wolverine.
title: Sony Announces Limited-Edition Marvel's Wolverine PS5 Bundle and Accessories in Striking See-Through Designs

description: Spotify is introducing AI Persona badges to distinguish AI-generated artist identities from human artists on its platform. The labels will be based on artist disclosures as well as Spotify’s own profile reviews. Users will see the badges across artist pages, Search and playlists from mid-September. Spotify will also keep labelled profiles out of editorial, algorithmic and personalised recommendations unless users follow them. The move expands Spotify’s existing measures for artist verification, AI credits, track information and protection against incorrectly attributed releases.
title: Spotify Will Label AI-Generated Artist Profiles With New AI Persona Badge

description: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will be equipped with a 2K resolution display, the company has confirmed. The tech firm claims that the phone will be the world’s first to boast a panel with the F2 luminescent material. The screen is claimed to deliver up to 2,000 nits peak brightness “across the entire screen” (translated from Chinese). The iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will deliver a 98 percent first frame brightness ratio, which is claimed to improve the screen’s visibility outdoors. The display of the iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will offer eye protection with less than 5 percent harmful blue light percentage. It will also feature a new “circular polarised light 2.0”, which is claimed to emit more “natural light for better eye protection”. Further, the display will offer a minimum brightness of 1 nit.
title: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra Display and Design Details Confirmed Ahead of August 18 Launch

description: The first and only total solar eclipse of 2026 is set to take place today (Wednesday). It presents skywatchers across parts of the Northern Hemisphere with an opportunity to witness the Moon completely cover the Sun. NASA says the path of totality will cross Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, Spain and a small part of Portugal, while a partial eclipse will also be visible over a larger region. Even with the totality lasting for less than two minutes for most, observers will have a small window of opportunity to witness a rare sky phenomenon.
title: Total Solar Eclipse Today: How to Watch Live Online, Timings, Safety Tips, and More

description: Bitcoin remained below Rs. 62 lakh on Wednesday as repeated resistance and subdued market activity kept investors cautious. Analysts said ETF demand, trading volumes and the US CPI reading could determine the cryptocurrency’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $64,000 as Investors Await US Inflation Data

description: Samsung’s new Galaxy Buds hearing features will let users check their hearing and adjust sound amplification according to their individual profiles. The Hearing Test uses pure-tone audiometry and provides an audiogram, while the Hearing Aid feature can enhance harder-to-hear sounds and reduce background noise. Samsung has developed the technology with the National Acoustic Laboratories and Samsung Medical Centre. The features will initially be available on the Galaxy Buds 3 Pro and Galaxy Buds 4 Pro in the US and select markets from Q4 2026.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds Hearing Aid Feature Gets FDA Clearance, to Roll Out in Q4 2026

description: Zack Nelson, host of the popular YouTube channel JerryRigEverything, put the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 through a series of durability tests. Despite the fragile-feeling inner screen, the new foldable proves to be a surprisingly durable handset. In the heat test, both displays get permanent damage after exposure to a lighter. The inner display burned after roughly seven seconds and the outer display after about ten seconds.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Durability Test Shows Strong Build, Fragile Inner Screen

description: Oppo Pad 5 Pro has reportedly been spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) database with the model number OPD2516. The listing on the certification website suggests that the tech firm could be planning to launch its new flagship tablet in India soon. The tipster has also shared the key specifications and features of the upcoming Oppo Pad 5 Pro, which appears to be identical to its Chinese counterpart. If this is true, then the Oppo Pad 5 Pro could debut in India more than four months after it was unveiled in China in April.
title: Oppo Pad 5 Pro India Launch Tipped as Tablet Appears on BIS Certification Website

description: Realme 16x 5G has been launched in India as the fifth model in the company’s Realme 16 lineup. The smartphone gets the same MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset as its more expensive sibling, the Realme 16T 5G. However, the phone surprisingly performs better in real-world scenarios and benchmark tests, thanks to its large AirFlow vapour chamber cooling solution. The Realme 16x 5G also delivers decent camera performance with its 50-megapixel shooter on the back. However, its biggest selling points are its design and long battery life.
title: Realme 16x 5G Review: A Sub-Rs. 26,000 Mid-Ranger With One Massive Selling Point

description: Realme 16x 5G has been launched in India with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset paired with up to 256GB of storage. It has an IP65 rating for dust and water resistance. It has a 6.8-inch HD+ (720x1,570 pixels) LCD panel with up to a 144Hz refresh rate. The handset includes a 5,300 sq mm AirFlow vapour chamber cooling system.
title: Realme 16x 5G Launched in India With MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: The Redmi Note 17 5G is now available for purchase in India. It was launched last week as the first model in the Xiaomi sub-brand’s latest Note-series lineup. The handset sports a 6.9-inch AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. It is among the first smartphones to be powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chip, coupled with up to 8GB of LPDDR4x RAM. For optics, it gets a 50-megapixel rear camera. The Redmi Note 17 packs an 8,000mAh battery with 45W wired charging.
title: Redmi Note 17 Goes on Sale in India With Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 Chip, 8,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Apple will raise the prices of all iPhone models by the September 8, with the launch of the new iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra, according to a tipster. The company will likely also raise the prices of its older models that are on sale, including the iPhone 17, iPhone Air, and iPhone 17e, while discontinuing the current flagship iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max, along with the 2024-launched iPhone 16 and iPhone 16 Plus. Further, the tipster claims that all new and old iPhone models will see a price hike of $100 (roughly Rs. 10,000).
title: iPhone 18 Pro Launch Could Bring Rs. 10,000 Hike to All iPhone Models, Claim Leaks

description: Anthropic on Tuesday announced that it is adding invisible watermarks to text generated by its artificial intelligence (AI) models. As per the company, the content will have a hidden signal that will be carried even when it is copied and pasted elsewhere. The move builds upon Anthropic’s decision to sign the European Union’s AI Act Article 50(2) Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content. Anthropic says Claude models launched on or after August 2, 2026, will support the marking system from day one, and the feature is rolling out globally.
title: Anthropic Adds Hidden Watermarks to Claude AI Text to Help Identify AI-Generated Content

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number 2609FRA74G, according to a report. According to the listing, the handset will be equipped with an octa-core chipset with the model number QTI SM6850, which is said to be the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 SoC. The Snapdragon chipset of the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max could feature four efficiency cores clocked at 2.02GHz, along with four performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.61GHz. The Geekbench listing also suggests that the handset will feature 7.22GB of RAM, which could be marketed by the Xiaomi sub-brand as 8GB of RAM.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max Visits Geekbench With Snapdragon 6 Series Chipset: Expected Specifications

description: Google is all set to host its annual Made by Google event today. At its annual hardware showcase, the Mountain View-based tech giant is expected to unveil its next-generation flagship smartphones, ubiquitously known as the Pixel 11 series. Like previous years, this the 2026 flagship lineup will also likely comprise four models. Apart from this, reports also indicate that the Pixel Watch 5 could also see the light of day. Google is also expected to mark its foray into the location tracker market with its first Bluetooth tracker, which could debut as the Pixel Tag.
title: Made by Google Event Today: How to Watch Pixel 11 Series Launch Live, What to Expect

description: The iPhone 18 series is expected to be launched later this year alongside the company's first foldable iPhone. While Apple has yet to confirm any details about the upcoming models in its next-generation flagship lineup, the rumour mill has pointed towards a staggered launch strategy. The Cupertino-based tech giant, however, seems to have provided a hint about its plans in the latest iOS 27 beta code, which reportedly references six unreleased iPhone models.
title: iOS 27 Beta 5 Update Reportedly Reveals Six Unreleased iPhones; iPhone Ultra, iPhone Air 2 Referenced
